[Vote entry link can be found here.](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1O3c2ZGWMUwBu_q2Yjr0nbfBOn9qD2T3A_zhYH8Q2ZHs/edit?gid=0#gid=0)

```{r setup}
library(gt)
source("scripts/shared.R")

senators <- load_senators()
ns       <- senator_name_sets(senators)
bills    <- load_bills()
votes    <- load_all_votes(ns)

# Render one committee's vote table (or a note if it has no votes yet).
vote_table <- function(code) {
  dat <- votes[[code]]
  if (is.null(dat)) {
    cat("No votes have been taken in this committee yet.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  dat |>
    # Link each bill to its page
    left_join(bills |> select(bill_measure, url_slug), by = c("Bill" = "bill_measure")) |>
    mutate(Bill = ifelse(is.na(url_slug), Bill,
                         sprintf("[%s](/%s/%s.html)", Bill, BILL_PAGES_DIR, url_slug))) |>
    # Blank senator cells -> NA so they display as an em dash
    mutate(across(any_of(ns$s_names_period), ~ ifelse(.x == "", NA, .x))) |>
    # Senator columns back to their display names
    rename_with(~ ns$s_names[match(.x, ns$s_names_period)], .cols = any_of(ns$s_names_period)) |>
    select(Date, Bill, Vote, Result, Dem_percent_sign, Rep_percent_sign, any_of(ns$s_names)) |>
    arrange(desc(Date)) |>
    gt() |>
    fmt_markdown(columns = "Bill") |>
    tab_options(table.width = pct(100)) |>
    cols_label(
      Vote = "Vote (Aye-No-Abstain-Absent)",
      Dem_percent_sign = "Democrat Support",
      Rep_percent_sign = "Republican Support"
    ) |>
    tab_header(
      title = md("**Votes**"),
      subtitle = paste0("Last updated: ", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z"))
    ) |>
    sub_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "—") |>
    opt_interactive(
      use_sorting = TRUE,
      use_search = TRUE,
      use_filters = FALSE,
      use_resizers = TRUE,
      use_highlight = TRUE,
      page_size_default = 20
    ) |>
    opt_row_striping()
}
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r}
vote_table("lgl")
```
